EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Soccer's cool. But ya ever thought
about sumo rasslin'?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Il calcio non è male,
ma preferisco il sumo.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Ich mag Fußball!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Aber Sumoringen
ist auch nicht zu verachten.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Futbol güzeldir. Ama sumo güreşini
hiç düşündün mü?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Non ci crederai, ma quando ero
giovane avevo un fisico da paura!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}How's your mom doin'? Ye take
care o' her now, ya hear?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Comment va ta maman ?
Prends bien soin d'elle, OK ?!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}A casa tutti bene?
Ricordati di scrivere ogni tanto!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Annen nasıl? Ona iyi bakıyorsun,
değil mi?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}I bet ye'll make one amazin' sumo
rassler if ye put yer mind to it!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}J'suis sûr que tu serais un très
bon sumo !{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Kafaya koyarsan harika bir sumocu
olursun bence!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN: {{TAG:0007:0004:}}Yar! How much weight can ye lift?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Tu fais souvent des pompes,
mon p'tit gars ?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT: {{TAG:0007:0004:}}Ma tu fai palestra, gamberetto?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Harrr!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Stemmst du Gewichte oder
so was, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Leichtmatrose?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}T'as l'air d'avoir de bons biscotos !
Tu veux qu'on fasse un bras de fer ?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Kolların güçlü görünüyor. Benimle
bilek güreşine tutuşmalısın!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Word to the wise: it be takin' more
than mere kindness ta be a man.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Vedrai che un giorno anche tu
diventerai un duro come me...{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Akıllıya bir söz: erkek olmak için
yalnızca iyi kalpli olmak yetmez.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}A true man o' the sea be havin' 
strong legs and a firm core!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Un vrai marin doit avoir des cuisses
d'acier !{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Un vero lupo di mare deve avere
gambe forti e cervello fino!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Ein echter Mann der See hat Beine
wie Bäume und ein Herz aus Feuer!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Gerçek deniz adamının bacakları
güçlü, beli sağlam olur!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN: {{TAG:0007:0004:}}Hey! Don't rock me boat!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}¡No te muevas tanto, que al final
va a zozobrar el bote, calamar!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Hé ! Reste un peu tranquille ou tu
vas nous faire chavirer !{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT: {{TAG:0007:0004:}}Ehi! Non dondolare la barca, eh?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Hey! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Halt die Füße still auf meinem
Schiff!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Halfway thar! Hope ye be ready ta
disembark!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}On est bientôt arrivés !
Prépare-toi à débarquer !{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Ci siamo quasi, dai!
Ancora un po' di pazienza!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Wir sind so gut wie da! Mach dich
bereit für die Landung, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Landratte!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
